items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Now, Lewis Nelson. Lewis Nelson's nickname was Doyle.

ctx.x: Yeah. I've always liked that about New Orleans. Everybody seems to have a nickname in New Orleans. Everybody you meet down there has got a nickname. So, there you were on the boat with the band.
Now, Lewis Nelson. Lewis Nelson's nickname was Doyle. What? Doyle. D-O-Y-L-E. Doyle.
Why would they call him Doyle?
